answer: BMW Group reported 802 work-related accidents in 2025 versus 891 in 2024 (−10.0%): employees and other BMW Group employees were 517 versus 502 (+3.0%), and temporary agency workers were 285 versus 389 (−26.7%). The total accident-frequency rate was 2.6 versus 2.9 (−10.3%); the employee rate was 1.9 versus 1.8 (+5.6%), and the temporary-agency-worker rate was 8.3 versus 10.7 (−22.4%). Four people died from work-related accidents in 2025 versus two in 2024: one BMW Group employee and three workers of external companies at BMW Group sites. Reported fatalities from work-related ill health were zero.
